description: This file defines the MacNodeLocationService class, which manages location updates asynchronously using CoreLocation. It implements location retrieval with timeout handling, conforming to CLLocationManagerDelegate, and provides methods to obtain current location with specified accuracy and timeout.

classes.name: MacNodeLocationService
classes.description: A service class responsible for obtaining the device's current location asynchronously, with timeout support, using CoreLocation's CLLocationManager.

methods.name: currentLocation
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves the current CLLocation with desired accuracy, maximum age, and timeout options.

methods.name: withTimeout
methods.description: Executes an asynchronous operation with a specified timeout, cancelling it if it exceeds the timeout duration.
